question: Qwen3-27B 4-bit quantization GSM8K accuracy benchmark score

sources.title: Qwen 3.6 27B Benchmark Deep Dive: The Measured Numbers
sources.snippet: TLDR Qwen 3.6 27B is the dense sibling in Alibaba's Qwen 3.6 family, alongside a 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts variant. Public community benchmarks put its NVFP4 quantization at 0.8446 accuracy on MMLU and 163 tokens per second peak decode on Blackwell-class hardware. The 35B-A3B sibling dominates independent tool-eval-bench runs.

sources.title: Benchmarking Qwen3.8 27B quantizations: 4-bit holds up, 1-bit collapses
sources.snippet: I test Unsloth GGUFs of Qwen3.8 27B (Q4_K_M, UD-Q2_K_XL, UD-IQ1_S) with llama.cpp on GPQA Diamond, IFBench, Terminal-Bench 2.1. Q4_K_M matches BF16 and fits an RTX 4090.
